scope: Original English basic-board standard semi-cooperative Nemesis, six original characters. English original manual including illustrated card text and scoped currentFAQ govern; PL/FR/DE original manuals supplement compatible details and expose differences without automatic precedence.
conclusion: PASS for included-claim source fidelity. The new Computer-icon definition follows original English p.24. Starting-kit linkage, active-player iteration, Item Counter and automatic Exploration effects, the combined endgame shuffle/draw/result procedure, exclusive Plasma Torch exception, Egg acquisition comparison and card/marker reference preserve the governing rules and stated exceptions. No actionable new unsupported claim or lost material caveat was found. The four essential source gaps remain disclosed; complete original-core card coverage is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

method.exact_current_text: Read the entire exact candidate15 snapshot in consecutive sections, including all repeated reference entries and retained source limitations. Candidate15 is a new text revision, not represented as byte-identical to a prior snapshot.
method.primary_source_work: Verified summary, ten source files and permitted prior source-only audit SHA256 values. Re-read original English PDF p.24 Computer definition, p.8 allocation/kit, p.10 rounds, p.11 endgame contamination, pp.13/22/25 Egg pickup/carrying/extraction, pp.14-15 Counter and Exploration effects, p.17 Destroyed Door exception, plus retained FAQ/image checks relevant to unchanged exceptions. Used existing .venv/bin/python with fitz for raw PDF text; retained earlier actual illustrated Plasma Torch and card cost inspections because those source bytes are unchanged.
method.retained_work: Carry forward the completed governing-English/scopedFAQ and readable-card-image checks from own pure-source context and the permitted full-iteration-10 source-only report. Retained localized corroboration remains supplemental without English precedence. No new full-language equivalence or unseen physical-card corpus audit is claimed.
method.output: Only candidate15/source-audit.json. All earlier reports and inputs preserved unchanged.

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.topic: Active-player iteration and skipping passed players
new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: Clockwise first-player order repeats for ordinary rounds while at least one active player has not passed. Passed players do not take more normal rounds, so their later Fire wounds are not repeatedly charged. The Player Phase proceeds to Events when all pass; one-Action-plus-pass and inability/unwillingness rules remain. Interruption after passing stays explicit and subject to normal requirements. Independent immediate game-end conditions remain separately stated.

sources.location: Player rounds; end conditions; Fire timing

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: Nest and Slime Room have no Item count. Other newly explored Room tiles are rotated to point the revealed Exploration number toward the printed Counter symbol. No Item count is added to printed Special Rooms or Search-prohibited Rooms; retained Search limits and counter0 exception remain.

sources.location: Counter setting; Search and Room exclusions

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: Both replace this Movement Noise roll. Silence ordinarily does nothing, with Slime converting it to Danger. Danger moves all eligible neighboring Intruders not already in Combat; if none eligible, adds Noise only in empty connected Corridors, including linked Technical Corridors. No second ordinary roll is added afterward. Retained Careful Movement/Reconnaissance overrides and Door movement rules remain operative.

sources.location: Careful Movement; Exploration and Noise; Doors

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.topic: Coupled endgame shuffle, draw and classification
new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: An Infected preliminary Scan or a pre-existing Larva triggers a complete shuffle of Action and Contamination from all three zones, top-four draw and result test. A Larva bypasses only the preliminary Scan. Any drawn Contamination kills, Infected or not; only Action cards means survival of this check, followed by Objective verification. No-Larva/no-Infected branch remains no draw; no automatic non-Infected removal is invented.

sources.location: Victory Check, Contamination A/B and Objective check

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: The positive statement that only Plasma Torch may close a Destroyed Door is equivalent to the English general prohibition with its sole named exception. Other Door-closing effects cannot bypass it. The active illustrated Plasma Torch retains current-Room-connected Corridor targeting, cost1, Out of Combat and reuse; Door pool and Noise exceptions remain unchanged.

sources.location: Destroyed Doors and sole Plasma Torch exception
Illustrated active Plasma Torch

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.topic: Egg acquisition comparison and Noise scope
new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: Nest-board Egg extraction is the local Take one Egg Room Action, cost2 and then Noise. A previously dropped Egg in the Character Room is one Heavy Object picked up by cost1 Basic Action with no Noise instruction of its own. Both become carried Heavy Objects and therefore use a Hand slot under ordinary capacity/drop rules. Normal Room/Basic Combat restrictions remain explicit. Loose Eggs do not replenish the Nest pool; pickup is not confused with a destruction attempt requiring Noise.

sources.location: Pick Up Heavy Object; Hands/Objects; Room restrictions; Nest extraction

new_or_reworded_claims_checked.details: Five-card refill, reshuffle on required own Action-deck draw when empty, first-player transfer after draw except turn1, face-up normal card discard routing and separate marker-pool returns match the main reference. sources.location: Discard areas; refill/token; Contamination; marker pools and Search/Storage

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: General payment totals and separate requirements
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: An Action card is itself discarded in addition to its printed extra-card cost: n + 1 total Action cards. Basic/Room/Item Actions do not add a nonexistent played Action card to their printed payment. Separate Ammo, components and one-use Item disposal remain required. Craft explicitly costs one Action card plus two matching discarded Item cards; availability and icon matching remain. No Action-card effect is treated as free merely because its printed extra cost is zero.

sources.location: Action costs; Action-card extra costs; Craft Item icon and procedure; reference

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Number allocation, Inventory matching and character draft order
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Help cards 1 through player count randomly establish Player Numbers; Inventory matches that number. Objectives still precede drafting. Drafting in Player Number order still draws two publicly, selects one and shuffles the unchosen card back before the next player draws; remaining deck only removed after all choose. Player1 starts with First Player token and retains it for the first turn, with later leftward transfers at the usual phase step. No new simultaneous draft or premature discard is introduced.

sources.location: Setup14-19; First Player token step

retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The new routing sentence restates normal discarded Action and gained Contamination placement, matching Item pile, each Event/Attack/Wound pile and marker supplies. retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: The new compact sequence retains Time/Self-Destruct, Intruder attacks, Intruder Fire injury checks, Event movement before Event effect, then bag development. retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.topic: Empty hand, declared Pass and end-of-round timing
retained_candidate14_new_wording_checks.details: Completing two Actions with no hand is not automatic Pass. The finished round receives its end effects; passing is declared in the later passing round, with Fire at the end of that round and possible further Bleeding as FAQ18 explains. Usual round eligibility and choice rules remain stated in Turn Structure, as does Interruption after passing with normal locality/card requirements. The timing clarification supplies no new early automatic Pass or immunity to that passing-round Fire.

retained_scope_statement_checks.topic: Unmarked card or Item Action eligibility
retained_scope_statement_checks.details: English p.12 permits unmarked effects in or out of Combat subject to requirements. Candidate13 explicitly preserves these as separate limits, eliminating possible table-level generalization to unmarked Basic/Room Actions. Positive In Combat and Out of Combat rows still use presence/absence of an Intruder in the Character Room; Eggs remain excluded.

retained_scope_statement_checks.topic: Fire Weakness and Nest Egg pool
retained_scope_statement_checks.details: English p.25 retains the normal one-uncarried-Egg destruction during each Fire Damage step. FAQ Rooms7 expressly gives the two-Egg Vulnerability modifier for the Nest pool represented on the Intruder board. Candidate13 now states that exact narrower scope, without asserting a wider interaction for loose Eggs. FAQ Rooms9 distinction between loose Objects and Nest hit points is preserved. No new Noise roll is assigned to passive Event Fire.
